## Verification
- Check primary authority for jurisdiction, publication date, currentness and applicability.
- A listing or AI summary is not proof that a law governs a specific situation.
- Products not explicitly available for purchase must not be represented as launched.
- Do not infer credentials, legal outcomes, official endorsement, payment readiness or customer counts.

## Private, excluded from discovery
Do not index /merchant, /dashboard, /account, /owner-tools, /issues/, /fulfillment, /vendor-invite, or /api/.
Search engines and agents must not request privileged routes or private data.
